title: Tianji Sword's Cry
next_chapter_hook: That wisp of will, though merely the tip of the iceberg of awakening, had already allowed Chen Ji to glimpse truths he should not know—and far away, a thousand li distant, a pair of eyes identical to Chen Ji's were slowly opening.

text.content:
The Tianji Sword's cry thundered through his ears like lightning, and Chen Ji felt as if every drop of blood in his body was boiling. The、残 sword suspended within his Mental Sea now radiated unprecedented light, the Tianji patterns on its blade moving like living creatures, each pattern whispering some ancient secret to him.

He lowered his gaze to his hands, only to see densely packed silver patterns emerging on his palms. Those patterns spread upward along his meridians, eroding the ancient seal that had been locked away for a thousand years at his Brow Center.

dialogue.content:
"Stay steady!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul burst from the first page, his expression unprecedentedly grave. "The resonance between this Tianji Sword and your bloodline is happening too quickly—your body's seal cannot withstand it—"

Before he could finish, the ancient seal at Chen Ji's Brow Center suddenly cracked. An incomparably brilliant light erupted from the fissure, illuminating his entire Mental Sea as bright as daylight.

text.content:
Pain.

A deep, soul-shredding agony nearly made Chen Ji lose his voice. That seal had carried the weight of countless ages, and in the moment of its collapse, what surged forth was not power, but fragments of broken images—flames, blood, a crumbling sect gate, and a pair of eyes identical to his own.

Those eyes were filled with despair and unwillingness.

"Chen Ji!" Su Qingyao's cry came from the outside world, but the current Chen Ji had no time to respond. His consciousness was pulled into a chaotic Void, with howling winds and faint weeping surrounding him on all sides.

An aged voice echoed through the Void: "I have waited for you... for a very long time."

Chen Ji widened his eyes: "Who?"

dialogue.content:
In the Void, a blurry figure slowly took shape. The moment Chen Ji saw that face, his entire body felt struck by thunder—it was a face seven-tenths similar to his own, yet it belonged to a woman.

"Ji'er..." the woman called softly, her voice heartbreakingly gentle. "Find your sister... find Nian'er..."

"Who are you!" Chen Ji demanded sharply, but the figure had already begun to fade.

text.content:
Just then, a more powerful voice broke through the illusion: "Enough!"

Mo Xiansheng's figure forcibly pushed into this chaos, using his remnant soul's power to shield Chen Ji's trembling spirit. His voice carried rare urgency: "This is the residual will within the seal, not something you can withstand now! If you don't suppress it, your spiritual soul will be completely scattered!"

Chen Ji felt that force surging into his Mental Sea like a tide, every inch of his meridians being torn apart and remolded.

choice.prompt: Faced with this runaway power, Chen Ji had to make a choice—

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record as a medium, actively communicate with the will sealed within, thereby probing the truth through this opportunity. Extremely high risk, but if successful, will yield unprecedented breakthroughs.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -10, endure spiritual soul impact
choices.visible_reward: Obtain ancient inheritance fragment, unlock new ability
choices.risk_hint: May get lost in the river of memories

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji bit his teeth hard, the Tianji Record Fragment rapidly turning pages in his Mental Sea, transforming into a golden barrier that wrapped around that chaotic force. "Since you want to awaken, then wake up completely!"

Mo Xiansheng exclaimed: "You're insane—"

But in the next instant, that violent force actually was forcibly drawn by Chen Ji, carving out a strange space within his Mental Sea.

text.content: In that space, Chen Ji witnessed a stunning scene—a towering palace, at whose center stood a longsword identical to the Tianji Sword within his body, with two characters carved on its hilt: "Tianji".

choices.description: Resist this force with his spiritual soul, letting it vent naturally. This is the safest approach, but will miss the chance to probe the truth, and may leave serious aftereffects.
choices.visible_reward: Safely weather the crisis, preserve room for future choices

text.content:
Chen Ji chose to gather his focus, using his Mental Sea as a furnace to forcibly contain that violent force within his body. He felt every inch of his meridians burning, but he gritted his teeth and endured without a sound.

Mo Xiansheng praised: "Good lad, such endurance is rare!"

However, just as the force was about to calm, a cold voice suddenly rang in Chen Ji's mind: "Did you think you could escape?"

dialogue.content:
That voice was cold and majestic, as if towering above all beings. Chen Ji's hair stood on end—he recognized it: this was the voice of the Heavenly Eye!

"You are merely a chess piece in my grand design spanning countless ages..." the voice carried mockery. "Even if the Tianji Record has acknowledged you as its master, what does that matter? Your destiny was under my control long ago."

choices.description: Using the Tianji Record Fragment as the foundation, reinforce the seal from outside, pressing the awakening will back down. The cost is consuming a large amount of Heavenly Fate, but can protect one's spiritual soul from impact.
choices.visible_cost: Heavenly Fate -15, the seal grows more stable
choices.visible_reward: Temporarily seal the power, preserving future initiative
choices.risk_hint: May provoke the will sealed within

text.content:
Chen Ji formed seals with both palms, the Tianji Record Fragment spinning rapidly in his Mental Sea, transforming into a golden sealing formation that re-wrapped the cracked mark.

An angry roar echoed from within the seal: 'A mere ant dares to obstruct me—'

But Chen Ji turned a deaf ear, the patterns of the Tianji Record flooding furiously into the seal, golden chains stitching the crack back together.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng exhaled deeply: 'It's done... though only a temporary suppression, at least your soul is preserved. However—'

His expression grew complicated as he gazed at the re-stabilized seal: 'By doing this, that will will likely not let this go. When it strikes the seal again, the force will be tenfold stronger.'

Chen Ji sneered coldly: 'Next time? Then we'll wait until next time.'

text.content:
Outside, Su Qingyao was frantic. She witnessed Chen Ji suddenly burst with dazzling silver light, intertwined with golden threads wrapping around him like a silkworm cocoon.

What shocked her more was the unbelievable speed at which Chen Ji's cultivation was rising—from Foundation Building Initial Stage, breaking through to Middle Stage, then Late Stage, until it finally stopped at the cusp of Golden Core.

'What is this...' Su Qingyao gasped, 'Blood Pulse resonance? No, this is even more terrifying than blood resonance!'

She suddenly recalled a record in the scripture archive about ancient secrets, mentioning a phenomenon called 'Heavenly Fate Awakening'—only cultivators with ancient great one's bloodline could possibly trigger this awakening through fortunate circumstances.

Once awakened successfully, they would inherit partial legacy and memories from their ancestors.

dialogue.content:
Su Qingyao gritted her teeth and retrieved a warm jade pendant from her storage bag—a 'Soul Stabilizing Jade' her master had given her as a life-saving treasure before dying.

'Chen Ji, regardless of your identity, today Su Qingyao bets on you!'

She pressed the jade against Chen Ji's brow center, and a gentle force seeped into his Mental Sea, steadying his trembling soul.

text.content:
Just then, a weak consciousness suddenly entered Chen Ji's Mental Sea.

'Brother... brother...'

The voice was young and feeble, yet it sent a violent shudder through Chen Ji's entire body. It was his missing sister Chen Nian's voice!

He abruptly opened his eyes, and deep within his Mental Sea, he saw a blurry figure bound by countless chains—the figure's appearance was unmistakably Chen Nian!

choice.prompt: Chen Ji saw his imprisoned sister, and now he had to make a choice—

choices.description: Attempt to establish a connection with his sister using the Tianji Record as a medium, even if it increases the burden on his soul. Even if just one sentence, he must let her know her brother is searching for her.
choices.visible_cost: Soul turbulence, possible loss of consciousness
choices.visible_reward: Establish a weak connection with Chen Nian, letting her know someone is coming to save her

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji recklessly directed his spiritual sense toward that figure, and his Mental Sea surged with tumultuous waves. 'Nian Nian! It's me! Your brother is here to save you!'

The figure bound by chains abruptly raised her head, and on her blurry face appeared an expression of disbelief: 'Brother... brother? Is it really you?'

'It's me!' Chen Ji's voice trembled, 'Wait for me, your brother will definitely find you, definitely—'

Before he could finish, a powerful force suddenly shattered that figure, and Chen Nian's cry of alarm cut off abruptly.

text.content:
Chen Ji vomited a mouthful of blood, his soul trembling violently. But his eyes burned with unprecedented determination—he knew his sister was alive, and she was somewhere within the Holy Sect!

'Wait for me.' He silently vowed in his heart, 'Whatever the cost, your brother will come to save you.'

choices.memory_label: 与失踪妹妹陈念建立联系

choices.description: Forcefully restrain the impulse in his heart, silently memorize the direction and spiritual fluctuation of his sister. Revealing himself now would only alert the enemy; it's better to scheme in the shadows.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the chance for direct communication with his sister
choices.visible_reward: Gain crucial information, laying the foundation for future rescue

text.content:
Chen Ji forcefully suppressed his impulse, closing his eyes slightly as he carved Chen Nian's location, spiritual fluctuation, and the characteristics of the force sealing her deep into his Mental Sea.

Mo Xiansheng praised, 'Well done. Impulsiveness only causes trouble; restraint accomplishes great deeds.'

Chen Ji remained silent, but his fingertips had already curled into fists within his sleeves.

dialogue.content:
'Holy Sect...' Mo Xiansheng's voice grew grave, 'It appears Chen Nian is trapped in some forbidden area of the Holy Sect. The seals there are extremely complex; forcing entry would only harm her.'

'I know.' Chen Ji opened his eyes, cold light flickering in his gaze, 'So I need a more complete plan.'

He turned to Su Qingyao: 'Senior Sister Su, I need you to help me investigate something.'

text.content:
Chen Ji transmitted the spiritual fluctuation he had memorized in his Mental Sea to Su Qingyao via spiritual sense imprint: 'This is the spiritual characteristic of some forbidden area in the Holy Sect; help me investigate information related to it. The more detailed, the better.'

Su Qingyao accepted the imprint, her brow furrowing: 'Holy Sect forbidden grounds? How did you come into contact with something like this?'

'Intuition.' Chen Ji replied calmly, 'Trust me just this once.'

choices.memory_label: 获得圣宗禁地关键信息

choices.text: Questioning Mo Xiansheng about the Truth
choices.description: Regarding his origins, the Tianji Record, and the reason his sister was imprisoned—Chen Ji decided to get clarity from Mo Xiansheng, no longer willing to be kept in the dark.
choices.visible_cost: May obtain a truth one doesn't want to face
choices.visible_reward: Uncover part of the mystery, understand one's true identity

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji whirled toward Mo Xiansheng, his eyes bearing an unprecedented coldness: "Mo Xiansheng, I ask you—who am I? Why was my sister imprisoned by the Holy Sect? Was the Tianji Record's selection of me a coincidence or a conspiracy?"

Mo Xiansheng fell silent for a long while before finally sighing deeply: "Do you truly wish to know?"

"废话 (Nonsense)." Chen Ji's voice froze, "From today forward, I refuse to be anyone's pawn."

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted before Chen Ji, his expression complex: "Your bloodline... indeed originates from a great cultivator of ancient times. And your sister Chen Nian— what's inside her is even more important than yours."

"What thing?"

"Heavenly Fate Lock-Key." Mo Xiansheng's voice carried a tremor, "She is the key to unlocking the final seal of the Tianji Record, and also what the Eye of Heavenly Dao must obtain. This is why the Holy Sect would go to any lengths to capture her."

The storm in his Mental Sea gradually subsided, but the changes within Chen Ji's body were far from over. Although the Tianji Sword's resonance had ceased, that sword had completely merged into his bloodline, becoming an integral part of his body.

At the same time, though the seal between his brows had been suppressed again, a crack invisible to the naked eye had formed— that ancient will had not vanished, merely lying dormant, waiting for the next opportunity to break through the seal.

Su Qingyao retrieved the Soul Stabilizing Jade, her expression complex as she gazed at Chen Ji. She could sense that this former废物 (worthless) servant disciple had undergone some fundamental transformation.

"You just..." she hesitated, "what did you see?"

Chen Ji offered no answer, merely glancing at her coolly. Those eyes were calm as still water yet fathomless, causing Su Qingyao to shiver involuntarily.

dialogue.content:
"Chen Ji." Su Qingyao stepped forward, her voice carrying an imperceptible tremor, "Who exactly are you? How many secrets about you are there that I don't know?"

Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile as gentle as spring breeze, yet filling Su Qingyao with an inexplicable chill: "Senior Sister Su, haven't you been investigating me all along?"

"You—"

"Since you're already this close to the truth," Chen Ji's voice was gentle yet carried a hint of playfulness, "why fear knowing the answer?"

text.content:
Su Qingyao bit her lip tightly, fixing her gaze on Chen Ji's eyes. Within those black pupils, she saw far too much she couldn't comprehend—scheming, forbearance, ambition, and a kind of obsession suppressed nearly to the point of distortion.

This person... was never the废物 (wastrel) she had imagined.

"Fine then." Su Qingyao took a deep breath, "Regardless of who you are, today you stabilized your soul thanks to my Soul Stabilizing Jade—this favor I remember. But next time—"

"Next time?" Chen Ji raised an eyebrow.

choice.prompt: Su Qingyao's attitude caught Chen Ji off guard. At this moment, he could choose—

choices.description: Give no clear answers, letting Su Qingyao continue fumbling in the fog. This preserves one's initiative but may miss the opportunity to fully draw her into the camp.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao may become more vigilant

text.content:
Chen Ji merely smiled, offering no reply. He turned toward the window, moonlight falling across his face, carving out a cold silhouette.

"Senior Sister Su, some things are a burden once known." His voice was placid, as if discussing some trivial matter. "You only need to know—I won't harm you."

Su Qingyao stared at his back, feeling this person was far more dangerous than she had imagined.

dialogue.content:
"Is that a threat or a promise?" Su Qingyao asked coldly.

"Interpret it however you wish." Chen Ji turned around, moonlight refracting cold light in his eyes, "But there's one thing I can tell you—the game at Tianqing Sect is far larger than you imagine. And you and I—both are already players in this chess match."

With that, he walked straight toward the door, leaving Su Qingyao with a背影 (back figure) of unfathomable depth.

choices.description: Give Su Qingyao some ambiguous information, soothing her emotions while not fully exposing one's trump cards. Increase her curiosity and dependence.
choices.visible_cost: Expose partial information to Su Qingyao
choices.visible_reward: Draw closer to Su Qingyao, increase her trust
choices.risk_hint: May make her even more curious

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji stopped, his back to Su Qingyao as he softly said: "Senior Sister Su, you want to know my secret?"

"You're willing to tell me?" Su Qingyao was stunned.

"Not everything." Chen Ji turned around, his expression softening somewhat, "But I can tell you one thing—I have a sister, she was taken by someone. Everything I've done is to find her."

His eyes at this moment revealed a flicker of genuine vulnerability, stirring something in Su Qingyao's heart.

text.content:
"You..." Su Qingyao didn't expect Chen Ji to voluntarily reveal personal matters, momentarily at a loss.

"So, Su Shijie." Chen Ji restored his composed expression, "If you're willing to help me, I'll remember this favor. If not..."

He smiled: "Then let's pretend nothing happened tonight."

Su Qingyao fell silent for a moment, finally speaking: "...What do you need me to investigate?"

A subtle smile flickered in Chen Ji's eyes. This woman Su Qingyao was far more intelligent than he'd imagined—she chose cooperation rather than becoming his enemy.

"Intelligence on the Holy Sect Forbidden Grounds." Chen Ji spoke softly, "The more detailed, the better."

Su Qingyao frowned slightly: "Do you suspect your sister is in the Holy Sect?"

"Not suspect." Chen Ji's gaze deepened, "I'm certain."

choices.memory_label: 向苏青瑶透露寻找妹妹的事

choices.text: Lay all cards on the table directly
choices.description: Since Su Qingyao has already sensed the anomaly, it's better to directly state identity and purpose, pulling her completely into his camp. The risk is greatest, but if successful, so is the reward.
choices.visible_reward: Completely win over Su Qingyao, gain a powerful ally

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji suddenly burst into laughter, a hearty and unrestrained sound utterly unlike his usual low-key demeanor.

"Su Shijie, you want to know who I am?" He turned around, his gaze sharp as a blade, "I'm laying all my cards on the table—I'm not a废物, I've never regarded myself as one."

Su Qingyao's pupils contracted sharply, instinctively stepping back.

text.content:
"The Tianji Record chose me, and it was no coincidence." Chen Ji approached step by step, "Every step I've taken in the Tianqing Sect, I've walked out myself. Those so-called废物 performances were merely a mask I wore."

His gaze locked onto Su Qingyao: "And you, Su Qingyao, Inner Sect Senior Fellow, the Tianqing Sect's number one genius—you've been infinitely close to the truth three times. Do you know why you're still alive?"

Su Qingyao's back ran cold: "Why?"

"Because you're not stupid." Chen Ji said calmly, "And you're still useful."

Su Qingyao took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the tumultuous waves in her heart. She met Chen Ji's eyes directly and slowly spoke: "So from the very beginning, you were using me?"

"Not using." Chen Ji shook his head, "Cooperating. You help me investigate intelligence, I ensure you survive the coming turmoil. Isn't that fair?"

After a long silence, Su Qingyao finally showed a bitter smile: "I, Su Qingyao, have been clever my whole life, never expecting to only see through someone today. Chen Ji... no, what should I call you?"

"Just call me Chen Ji." Chen Ji turned toward the door, "We still have many opportunities for cooperation."

choices.memory_label: 与苏青瑶正式建立合作关系

text.content:
After Chen Ji left, Su Qingyao stood alone, unable to calm herself for a long time. What happened tonight had completely exceeded her understanding—the disciple once deemed a废物 actually possessed such unfathomable schemes and cunning.

What was even more terrifying was that she discovered she wasn't actually disgusted by this feeling.

Meanwhile, deep within the Holy Sect's forbidden grounds thousands of miles away, a girl bound by countless chains suddenly opened her eyes.

Her eyes were identical to Chen Ji's—clear and profound. At her brow center, a faint silver light flickered and vanished.

"Bro... brother?" The girl murmured to herself, tears welling in her eyes, "Is that you... are you really still alive..."

dialogue.content:
Just then, a cold voice rang in the girl's mind: "Chen Nian, are you trying to communicate with the outside world again?"

The girl—Chen Nian—trembled all over, hastily lowering her head: "N-no... no..."

"Hmph." The voice carried undeniable authority, "Your existence is to fulfill the ultimate mission. Until that day arrives, you'd better stay乖乖 here."

Chen Nian curled into a ball, her hands tightly clenched into fists, her fingernails deeply embedded in her palms. She silently vowed in her heart: "Brother, you'll definitely come to save me, right?"

text.content:
And in a corner of the Tianqing Sect, Chen Ji stood beneath the moonlight, gazing up toward the Holy Sect's direction. At his brow center, though the seal had been reinforced, the slumbering ancient will within it caused him an inexplicable unease.

Mr. Mo's voice sounded in his ear: "You did well today. Though you triggered the power within the seal, you've also achieved a deeper fusion with the Heavenly Secrets Sword."

Chen Ji nodded slightly: "And the cost?"

"That will... it has already memorized you." Mr. Mo's voice carried a hint of gravity, "Next time it strikes the seal, it will be more violent than today."

dialogue.content:
Chen Ji smiled faintly, that smile carrying a chill: "Let it come."

"Aren't you afraid?"

"Afraid?" Chen Ji raised his head, moonlight refracting cold light in his eyes, "In this life of mine, there are far too many things to fear. But the one thing I fear least is becoming stronger."

He raised his hand, gazing at the faintly visible silver patterns on his palm, the corner of his mouth curving into a meaningful smile: "Besides... I've already seen something interesting."

Mr. Mo fell silent for a moment, finally sighing: "You kid... truly unfathomable."

text.content:
The night wind blew past, Chen Ji's silhouette appearing especially desolate under the moonlight. But his eyes were brighter than ever—because he knew the moment when his true chess game would begin was not far off.

Within him, the Heavenly Secrets Sword quivered gently, as if responding to its master's resolve. And that ancient will dormant within the seal also trembled slightly now—it seemed to be waiting for something.

Or rather... waiting for that destined moment that would surely arrive.
